inference_for_followup: Cross-platform references show a larger relative prefill throughput gap than decode. Investigating the single-card prefill path is a reasonable direction; no local component bottleneck has been attributed by a profile.
limitations: Community results are whole-system references, not a controlled GPU comparison.
Our no-prefill-borrow keeps 2048-token chunks; the 5090 report uses 8192-token chunks with borrowing.
Host CPU, CPU quotas, PCIe transfers, source versions, seed defaults, warmup schedules and vision reserves differ.
Historical automatic-probe and multi-card results remain preserved in results.json.
